name: vscode-web
description: VS Code in the browser (Microsoft's official [VS Code web server](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/remote/vscode-server), with access to the Microsoft Marketplace)

acceptLicenseTerms.description: REQUIRED: set to true to accept the Microsoft VS Code Server license terms (https://aka.ms/vscode-server-license). The feature fails to install when the terms are not accepted.

connectionTokenFile.description: Path to a file containing the connection token used for authentication. When empty, the server starts without a connection token (intended to be used behind an authenticating reverse proxy such as Coder).

defaultFolder.description: The folder to open by default when no folder is specified in the URL. Can also be passed per-request via the '?folder=' query parameter.

disableWorkspaceTrust.description: Disable Workspace Trust feature. This only affects the current session.

extensions.description: Comma-separated list of VS Code extensions to install from the Microsoft Marketplace. Format: 'publisher.extension[@version]' (e.g., 'ms-python.python,ms-python.vscode-pylance').

extensionsDir.description: Path where extensions are installed. Defaults to a directory under the server data dir.

host.description: The address to bind to for the VS Code web server. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

logFile.description: Path to a file to send stdout and stderr logs to from the VS Code web server.

logLevel.description: Log level of the VS Code web server. One of 'trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'critical', 'off'. Defaults to the server's built-in default ('info').

port.description: The port to bind to for the VS Code web server.

serverBasePath.description: Path under which the server is served (e.g. when running behind a path-routing reverse proxy).

serverDataDir.description: Directory where the server stores its data. Defaults to '~/.vscode-server'.

socketPath.description: Path to a socket to listen on instead of host:port.

telemetryLevel.description: Telemetry level of the VS Code web server.

userDataDir.description: Directory where user data (settings, state) is kept. Defaults to a directory under the server data dir.

version.description: The version of VS Code to install (e.g. '1.101.0'). If empty, installs the latest stable version.

appOpenIn.description: The way to open the app in Coder. Defaults to 'slim-window'.

appShare.description: The sharing level to use for the app in Coder. Defaults to 'owner'.

appGroup.description: The group to use for the app in Coder. Defaults to 'Web Editors'.
